about: Meshes whose standing hull is compiled by qbsp (the checked union, chim.models variant_unit) when the build's model hull mode is auto: their piece chain is deeper than routed_hull.CHAIN_DEPTH_LIMIT and the routing cannot divide it, so the routed hull stays one chain over the limit. Each entry is measured; a union that loses or adds pieces is refused and the routed hull is kept (collision_union_fallback_reasons).
